action: Preserve v1r21 unchanged. Correct only the generic framework after archiving this attempt: enforce exact five-page semantics in final readiness, constrain peer-review required revisions to actions resolvable from existing frozen artifacts and capabilities, and strengthen underfilled-manuscript revision instructions. Any future autonomous attempt must start fresh from the original frozen scientific inputs without reuse of v1r21 scientific decisions, results, analyses, or manuscript content.
diagnosis: Three generic framework issues were exposed. First, the manuscript format reviser did not expand an underfilled 3-page manuscript to the required 5-page budget despite exhausting the bounded revision loop. Second, the final readiness judge treated page_count <= maximum_pages as a passed page-compliance gate even though deterministic publication validation correctly reported uses_full_page_budget=false and passed=false. Third, peer review continued to require revisions that could require retrospective preregistration modification, new post-lock scientific work, or unavailable external publication capabilities instead of converting such requests into explicit artifact-grounded limitations or disclosures.
observed_failure: The fresh autonomous run completed scientific execution, analysis, peer review, manuscript revision, IEEE compilation, and all bounded format-revision attempts. The final manuscript compiled successfully but remained 3 pages after all five format revisions instead of the required exact 5 pages. Peer review also remained non-finalisable after all three review rounds because required revisions were still present.
